decisions.reason: Copper-coated glass packaging substrates build directly on the firm's long glass processing and patterning know-how. That gives it strong absorptive capacity to read customer feedback and refine the product for 3D integration and high-frequency markets that fit its strategy of moving into higher-value applications.

Laser-based through-glass via structuring was launched recently and is prominently presented on its own page. It extends the firm's core glass competencies into a strategic semiconductor packaging technology, and the firm's own R&D and EU research cooperation provide the knowledge base to keep improving it.
